summary: Harden the canonical screen-workspace composition used by the already-merged accounting structural redesign: add one reusable workspace navigation pattern and allow the content pane to remain unsurfaced so modules do not accumulate card-on-card wrapper layers.
protectedReason: The owner explicitly requested protection against patch-on-patch UI construction. This change modifies only the canonical screen-layout foundation so existing structural workspaces can reuse navigation and avoid an unnecessary visual surface around content. It does not create another accounting implementation or change business ownership.
